name: Timber Knot Release
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Orbit the wooden turntable and release every carved beam from the knot. Each beam moves one cell at a time along its visible gold axis; inspect the new clearance after every accepted shift. Use direct dragging for full interaction. Do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, page state, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload, navigation, extensions, external applications, or hidden implementation state.
